data.title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚的金色花嫁
data.description: 【漫展摄影棚·黄昏】美花莉穿着细节华丽的白金婚纱站在柔光背景前，微卷的栗棕长发绕过头纱，手里捧着圣洁的花束；她熟练摆出镜头角度后，忽然收起营业笑容，给镜头一个真实的害羞眨眼。
data.action: 柔光棚下完成镜头角度后收起营业笑，给镜头真实害羞眨眼
data.lighting: golden studio light with soft pastel backdrop
data.mood: 职业偶像也会为花嫁心动
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana poses before the convention studio's soft pastel backdrop in a white-and-gold bridal cosplay gown, holding a fantasy bouquet against satin and gold ribbons. After finding her practiced angle, she replaces the promotional smile with a shy real wink. The vertical medium-full view includes the layered veil beside chestnut curls. Golden studio light illuminates the bouquet and veil ridges, with gentle skirt shadows grounding the pose against the backdrop.
